verified_key_information_units.information: Gigasun reported revenue of SEK 239.7 million (up 9.8% YoY) and operating profit of SEK 73.5 million (up 21.1% YoY). Net profit was SEK -7.2 million, impacted by a SEK 3.8 million currency effect and SEK 3.5 million one-off cost; excluding these items, adjusted net profit was SEK 0.1 million. The full-year profit increase was significantly driven by a record Q3 with production up 36% and profit up 275% compared to Q3 2024.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenues amounted to SEK 239.7 (218.3) million... Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million... Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million... The most notable development during the year was our record quarter in Q3. Production increased by 36 percent and profit rose by as much as 275 percent compared with the same period the previous year.

details.completeness_justification: All six key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S3 (installed capacity increase to 395.8 MW from 340.1 MW and expansion to 216 sites). K2 is covered by S2 (revenue increase), S5 (operating profit increase), S6 (net profit), and S12 (currency effect). K3 is covered by S7 and S8 (financing details). K4 is covered by S13 and S14 (regulatory tariff adjustments). K5 is covered by S2 (production increase and CO2 reduction implied by production growth). K6 is covered by S18 (signed orders). No material omissions affect the overall understanding.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. All statements build logically upon each other, showing consistent cause-effect relationships (e.g., capacity expansion driving revenue growth, refinancing reducing interest costs). The narrative flows from operational highlights to financial performance, then to market challenges and strategic outlook. While several quantitative metrics are presented, none contradict each other, and the summary acknowledges offsetting factors (e.g., currency headwinds partially offset by translation benefits). Organization is clear with progressive disclosure of financials, operational drivers, and strategic context. No unnecessary repetition is present, and all elements contribute to a unified portrayal of the company's performance and positioning.
